result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 0 FOUND, 6 NOT_FOUND
evidence: All six rules assessed across complete production Java services/controllers/entities/repository and asynchronous upload.js; no application-created worker threads, executors, custom locks, or shared mutable request caches found.

CWE-543/CWE-567 NOT_FOUND: Spring singleton controllers have final injected PhotoService references; PhotoServiceImpl.java:32-47 has a logger, constant pixel cap, final repository/configuration fields, and a MIME list that is never mutated after construction. UploadResult, byte arrays, photo entities, response maps, and ImageReaders are per invocation.

CWE-662/CWE-667/CWE-820/CWE-821 NOT_FOUND: database operations execute through the Spring Data repository under @Transactional (PhotoServiceImpl.java:28-30,54,68,224,234); no custom lock acquisition/release or unprotected in-memory read-modify-write state was identified.

PhotoServiceImpl.deletePhoto at 199-216 performs find-then-delete, but concurrent deletion alone was not treated as a security vulnerability without a violated authorization, invariant, or exclusive-access requirement. Mere use of singleton @Service is not sufficient evidence of unsafe synchronization.
upload.js:90-133 performs asynchronous network operations using function-local FormData and response state; UI progress races do not establish a security-sensitive shared-state defect.

No parallel-request stress test, database isolation verification, cross-instance test, or third-party concurrency implementation audit was performed; NOT_FOUND is limited to confirmed application-source patterns.

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
